about: A ladder of powers of ten with things placed at their true size, each arriving as it is named, and the span from smallest to largest: orders of magnitude, scale from tiny to vast, sizes, distances, times, money.

values.about: each thing's value, in one unit

unit.about: the unit, written after the powers of ten

span.about: 1 marks the span from the smallest to the largest with its factor

when.about: moments each thing arrives; else when its name is said, or one after another
